name: example-agency-publication
title: publication page kind
description: A static publication or media page kind: masthead, lead story, topics, latest stories, running series, archive, optional contributors, newsletter sign-up and membership. Fits magazines, newsletters, independent media and blogs. Composed from ten vendored HyperUI blocks with Tailwind compiled once and inlined; no page kind JavaScript.

query.en: Use the publication family for a static publication or media mock (a magazine, newsletter, independent media title or blog): masthead, lead story, topics, latest stories, series, archive, optional contributors, a newsletter sign-up and membership. Ask for the title, what it covers and who it is for, generate a schemaVersion 2 publication typed recipe through the bundled trusted compiler, and render it. This is a page kind, not a decoded client site: every business fact in the reference fixture is a placeholder.
